answer: Let standing decay unless refreshed by recent verified work. Influence is a sum under a short half-life, so an identity that falls quiet slides off its glacier toward zero — today's work, not a permanent grant. A farmer cannot stockpile dormant fakes and wake them for a vote: each must do real graded work every epoch merely to hold weight, so a swarm pays a recurring cost per head or melts away. The promise of cheap idle clones becomes a fable, and only the active falcon keeps its altitude.
